topic: Google NotebookLM Free Tier (100 notebooks, 50 sources, 500k words, flashcards, Audio Overviews)
caption:
Save this if you're drowning in 200-page PDFs before exams.

If you want free AI study tools instead of paid PDF wrappers, Google NotebookLM for students gives 100 notebooks at $0. Each notebook holds 50 sources up to 500,000 words.

You get PDF to flashcards AI, practice quizzes, mind maps, and Audio Overviews, with a shared compute budget that resets every 5 hours.

#notebooklm #aitoolsforstudents #studyhacks
